description: Tool to create a recurring audience list that automatically generates new audience lists daily based on the latest data. Use when you need to automate audience list creation and reduce quota token consumption.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating a recurring audience list under a GA4 property.

activeDaysRemaining.description: Counter decreasing daily. Defaults to 180 days for Analytics 360 properties (max 365) and 14 days for standard properties (max 30).
activeDaysRemaining.title: Active Days Remaining

audience.description: Audience resource name identifying the audience being listed. Format: properties/{property_id}/audiences/{audience_id}.
audience.title: Audience

dimensions.description: List of dimensions requested and displayed in the audience list response.

dimensionName.description: API name of the dimension (e.g., deviceId, userId, isAdsPersonalizationAllowed).
dimensionName.title: Dimension Name

dimensions.title: Dimensions

parent.description: Parent property resource name where the recurring audience list will be created. Format: properties/{property_id}.
parent.title: Parent

webhookNotification.description: Configuration for receiving webhook notifications about recurring audience list status.

channelToken.description: Optional token for source verification, included in X-Goog-Channel-Token header. Max length: 64 characters.
channelToken.title: Channel Token

uri.description: HTTPS endpoint URL to receive POST notifications. Must have valid SSL certificate and reply with HTTP 200 within 5 seconds. Max length: 128 characters.
uri.title: Uri

webhookNotification.title: WebhookNotification

dimensionName.title: Dimension Name

CreateRecurringAudienceListResponse.description: Response model for CreateRecurringAudienceList action, representing the created RecurringAudienceList resource.

audienceDisplayName.description: Descriptive display name for the audience (e.g., 'Purchasers').
audienceDisplayName.title: Audience Display Name

audienceLists.description: Audience list resource names for instances created for this recurring audience list, ordered with most recent first.
audienceLists.title: Audience Lists

dimensions.description: Dimensions requested and displayed in the audience list response.
dimensions.title: Dimensions

name.description: Resource name assigned at creation. Format: properties/{property}/recurringAudienceLists/{recurringAudienceList}
name.title: Name
